Project Context Instructions (SaaS Restaurants)
nodes.rationale: Operational guide listing the mandatory stack, the pre-built knowledge graph workflow, and authoritative documentation to read before architectural changes.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: Project maintains a pre-constructed knowledge graph in graphify-out/graph.json and auto-updates it after every commit via post-commit hook; queries for architecture/impact questions.

nodes.label: Technical Specifications (Single Source of Truth)
nodes.rationale: Authoritative engineering standards for financial resilience, multi-tenant security, and edge performance; governs AI orchestrators and developers.

nodes.label: Pago Móvil (Venezuelan P2P Payments)
nodes.rationale: Customer pays the restaurant's bank account; restaurant receives full amount; superadmin collects commissions manually/officially. Local rail decouples from international gateway trap.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Payment Validation
nodes.rationale: Technology optimizes flow but human control ensures final capital validation; adaptive to local payment rails and acts as the financial resilience axis.

nodes.label: Financial Sovereignty / Gateway Decoupling
nodes.rationale: Decoupling from global payment processors avoids predatory fees and settlement delays; local P2P Mobile Payments deliver immediate cash availability and reduced transaction costs.

nodes.label: QR Ordering with Table Identifiers
nodes.rative: Dynamic QR codes with integrated table identifiers eliminate friction between diner and service, reducing operational latency from menu discovery to payment confirmation.

nodes.label: Legacy Custom JWT Auth (removed)
nodes.rationale: python-jose + passlib custom JWT implementation removed; hashed_password field deprecated; Supabase Auth adopted as SSOT.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth (Source of Truth)
nodes.rationale: Supabase Auth handles token issuance, hashing and validation; get_supabase()/get_supabase_admin() client factories, create_auth_user(), get_user_by_token().

nodes.label: Supabase Realtime (postgres_changes)
nodes.rationale: postgres_changes channel notifies Admin Dashboard of new orders and PAYMENT_SENT, and the diner page of order status changes.

nodes.label: Row-Level Security (RLS) Isolation
nodes.rationale: Data isolation must be absolute; security delegated to the database engine, not the application layer. Warning: UPDATE silently affects 0 rows without explicit SELECT policy; helpers get_user_restaurant_id() and is_superadmin().

nodes.label: Async Repository Pattern
nodes.rationale: ORM objects prohibited in the service layer to avoid 'Detached Instance' errors; repositories map results to Pydantic models before returning. Business logic consumes flat validated schemas.

nodes.label: Order Status State Machine
nodes.rationale: PENDING → PAYMENT_SENT → CONFIRMED → PREPARING → READY → DELIVERED, with CANCELLED reachable from any state; payment status PENDING → VERIFIED / REJECTED.

nodes.label: Commission System ($0.10 per Confirmed Order)
nodes.rationale: Commission shown as 'Mantenimiento de la App' in the customer receipt; restaurant collects it from customer and superadmin collects manually; commission_count is not auto-updated yet.

nodes.label: CommissionService (backend)
nodes.rationale: record_commission(order_id, restaurant_id) creates commission row and increments restaurant.commission_count at CONFIRMED transition.

nodes.label: P2P Fraud Prevention (Unique Bank Reference)
nodes.rationale: Composite unique index (restaurant_id, bank_reference) blocks bank-reference reuse; audit trail via order_status_history.

nodes.label: Mock-based Frontend (current state)
nodes.rationale: 100% of menu and admin UI runs on mock data; src/lib/supabase.ts and src/lib/api.ts exist but are not consumed by components; phased migration to real Supabase queries required.

nodes.label: Authorization Matrix (SuperAdmin / Admin / Diner)
nodes.rationale: SuperAdmin governs tenants and collects commissions; Admin performs menu/table CRUD and HITL payment verification; diner is registration-free via QR table_id.

nodes.label: SQL Migration Files
nodes.rationale: Numbered migrations 001_create_tables, 002_rls_policies, 003_seed_data are canonical; 000_full_schema.sql and full_schema.sql are duplicates to be removed.
